lines.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write to the church of the Thessalonians, wishing them grace and peace.
Paul's team thanks God always, recalling the Thessalonians' work of faith, labor of love, and enduring hope in Jesus Christ.
Paul knows God has chosen them, because the gospel came in word, in power, and in the Holy Spirit.
They imitated Paul and the Lord, welcoming the message despite suffering, and became an example in Galatia and Achaia.
They turned from idols to serve God and await His Son from Jerusalem, whom He raised from the dead.
